title: First Aid Kit 260 Pieces – Home, Car & Camping
descriptionHtml:
"Do we have any bandages?" – and everyone looks in different places

A scraped knee doesn't wait while you rummage through the bathroom cabinet. When something happens you want everything in one place – not scattered across three drawers.

The solution: 260 pieces, sorted and ready

A complete kit in a compact red bag: bandages, adhesive strips, tweezers and the things you hope you'll never need – including a fire steel for emergencies outdoors. One in the hallway, one in the car, one in your pack.

Features

  • Everything in one place when it's urgent – 260 pieces
  • Find the right item right away – sorted compartments
  • Handles an emergency outdoors – fire steel included
  • Easy to take along – car, boat, hiking, camping
  • Easy to spot in your bag – bright red color

Change of Mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
